scope: Isolated joint acoustic/language quality reference, not product selection or a device endpoint test

base.download: Config and tokenizer only; construct built-in Qwen2 then strictly copy every checkpoint tensor, no partial weights or custom remote code

inputs.selection: All original 20 IDs in original manifest order; same labels, byte lengths and audio SHA, no reselection or relabeling
inputs.padding: No artificial trailing silence or extra wait

method.device: CPU only, at most 2 intra-op threads and 1 inter-op thread
method.math: Official encoder/model/generate and official log-mel function; original float32 encoder and bfloat16 Qwen construction, strict checkpoint copy; report compatibility failures instead of silently changing precision
method.prompt: The first official YAML entry under <TRANSCRIBE> <BACKCHANNEL> <COMPLETE>, fixed before first prediction, including its original leading character; no prompt sweep
method.generation: Original deterministic generate parameters, max_new_tokens=100, do_sample=false, num_beams=1, repetition_penalty=1.05, eos=151643; no custom threshold or token/semantic postprocessing
method.classification: Exactly one of complete/incomplete/backchannel/wait must occur at the end; report other tags and invalid output separately. Do not map backchannel/wait to ignoring a user or cancelling work

repeatability.selection: After the first full 40 calls, repeat the original failure plus the first two other incomplete IDs and first two complete IDs, full variant, twice more
repeatability.purpose: Report action changes; retain every output, including errors

qualification: Original premature decision must be corrected and all new premature decisions, missed complete utterances, other tags and invalid outputs reported. A failure stops product selection; no threshold/prompt sweep or hiding failures with aggregate accuracy
timing: Record model load, first feature/generation and warm feature/generation separately. CPU reference includes waveform loading/resampling/features and generation, not capture/VAD/transport/Agent/TTS and not phone latency
boundaries: No service startup, deployment, ADB, microphone, private recording, paid API, product prompt or permission change.
The model is a large research reference. Passing quality alone does not authorize a server placement/API or replacement of the confirmed phone-side pure-audio design.
No expanded real-cadence replay if the fixed corpus fails. Existing failures remain in the evidence.
